original_test_intent: Demonstrate that each approved networking port transitions down and up correctly for five OS-controlled cycles, loses and regains bounded peer connectivity, and remains healthy afterward.
original_method: After engineering selects Ethernet or IB/VPI authority, use the matching interface and state tools for exactly five controlled cycles per isolated port, recording traffic, state, counters, logs and recovery under independent OOB access.
manual_activity: Engineer resolves port protocol/evidence and approves isolated targets and recovery; agent may execute exactly five controlled cycles only after that decision.
required_inputs: Authoritative Ethernet versus InfiniBand/VPI target mode and stable device/port/interface mapping
Approved up/down evidence: ethtool/ip carrier for Ethernet and/or ibstat State/Physical state for IB
Peer/IP and bounded ping or protocol-appropriate health probe
Five-cycle dwell/recovery timeout and expected LinkUp/Disabled or equivalent matrix
Independent OOB/console, service-impact exclusions, recovery and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Exclude management/BMC/storage/cluster/production paths and prove OOB recovery
Capture complete baseline and change one approved interface at a time
Stop on access loss, route/bond/bridge drift, persistent link failure, peer impact or error logs
Restore final state and preserve every cycle; no log clearing or automatic retry
Do not use ibstat for a plain Ethernet port or ethtool alone for an IB acceptance without approval
agent_execution_scope: Collect identity, mode, link, routing, peer and health baseline
Execute five approved down/up cycles with bounded probes and matching state evidence
Verify final state and complete per-cycle recovery
Do not choose protocol authority, touch unspecified ports, auto-recover/retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact targets, five-cycle timing, impact and recovery
Review complete evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: its read-only ethtool snapshot omits active flaps, five cycles, ping and the unresolved ibstat acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protocol-matched OS commands on identity-locked ports for exactly five approved down/up cycles, with bounded peer probes and complete per-cycle carrier/physical-state evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Per-port OS link flap, ping, five repetitions, LinkUp/Disabled expectations, final normality and 10/10 timing fields are preserved pending protocol authority.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a protocol-specific five-cycle state-transition matrix on isolated ports with bounded reachability and complete recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the Ethernet/IB evidence branch explicit and adds safe targeting, timing and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Neither the ping nor physical/carrier state requirement is discarded while the conflict awaits decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: VPI devices can expose different netdev and IB state semantics; wrong mode assumptions can produce false failures or strand remote access.

project_override_considerations: Engineering may split Ethernet and IB/VPI variants; one branch's evidence must not be used to pass the other.
expected_evidence: Protocol decision and approved port/interface/peer map
Exactly five timestamped down/up transitions per port
Per-cycle bounded connectivity failure/recovery and protocol-correct state/counters
Complete system/SEL health and final restored state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row is named Ethernet and uses IP ping, but requires ibstat Physical state LinkUp/Disabled; authority cannot be inferred for a plain Ethernet versus VPI/IB target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; engineering can resolve the evidence branch later without blocking subsequent cases.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row63 Wistron-Networking-00046-V002: decide whether the five-cycle target is Ethernet, InfiniBand/VPI, or split variants; provide exact device/physical-port/netdev/IB-port mode mapping, authoritative up/down evidence (ethtool/ip carrier versus ibstat State/Physical state), peer/IP or IB health probe, LinkUp/Disabled equivalence, cycle dwell/recovery timeout, non-management exclusions, independent OOB/console, rollback/recovery and invalid-run policy. ethtool-only or ibstat-only evidence must not silently cover the other protocol branch.

review_improvement: Preserves the five-cycle link and ping objective while preventing an unapproved Ethernet/InfiniBand evidence substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ethernet carrier and IP reachability are netdev properties, while ibstat reports InfiniBand HCA port state; on a VPI adapter these may correspond only under a declared port mode and mapping. Therefore the same physical connector cannot be judged with mixed terminology until engineering fixes the authoritative branch and equivalence.
